info.title: LV24 Brain Local Control API
info.description: Frozen localapi-v1 contract. Every error uses the sanitized {error:{code,message}} envelope; a method mismatch returns 405 with an Allow header. See docs/localapi-v1.md.

delete.description: Removes the connection configuration; items, checkpoints and credentials are retained (as with `brain connection remove`).

post.description: Writes a secret through the credential store; the value is never returned.

get.description: Recent run summaries without error text. Items carry connectionId plus the snake_case connection_id and project_ids of the connection when it is known; actor is omitted because run records do not persist a trigger.

200.description: Recent run summaries without error text

post.description: Requests cancellation of a queued or running job. A 202 means the request was accepted, not that the job has already stopped.

200.description: Registered project IDs, names, checkout paths and path provenance

get.description: Reads a project's state and its CAS revision.

put.description: Changes the given state fields. expected_revision was returned by a previous read; a mismatch is 409 with the current revision in error.current_revision and writes nothing. Omit expected_revision for an unconditional write.

post.description: Marks the project state reviewed and optionally replaces its trust, like brain state review. Provenance-only: the state revision does not move, so a repeated call with the same expected_revision is an idempotent no-op. expected_revision makes the write a compare-and-swap inside the store's atomic state update; a stale value returns 409 with error.current_revision and writes nothing. reviewed must be true when present.

200.description: The state with its revision after review

get.description: Newest-first curated records, paginated. project is optional: omit it or pass all_projects=true to read every project the API serves. due_review keeps records whose review date has passed.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Repeated or comma-separated: note, decision, attempt, handoff.

get.description: One record with its body, links, backlinks, relations, validity and provenance. max_tokens bounds the body; history adds the timeline of the same kind around the record. Relation rows carry target_kind when the target is live.

patch.description: Edits the text of one record in place: title and body (plus tags on a note), never its ID, kind, project, provenance, validity, relations or review state. Body is the note text, the decision context, the attempt result or the handoff summary; a handoff has no title. The stored body is kept in bounded history. expected_updated_at makes the edit a compare-and-swap; a stale value returns 409 with error.current_revision and writes nothing. allow_duplicate accepts text another live record of the same kind already has. An unreviewed record stays unreviewed.

200.description: The edited record with its body

post.description: Moves one record to its project trash through the same use case as brain record trash. The move is reversible and never deletes a file; an unknown record is 404 and a hand-written note without an id marker is 400 validation.
Restores one trashed record. An id that is not in the project trash is 404.

Marks one record reviewed and optionally replaces its trust, like brain record review. Provenance-only: body, ID, kind, classification and review date are untouched and the write is journalled. The record id is unambiguous inside its project; project is optional when the API serves exactly one project. expected_updated_at makes the write a compare-and-swap; a stale value returns 409 with error.current_revision and writes nothing. reviewed must be true when present.

200.description: The record summary after review, with its cleared quarantine

get.description: Ranked search over curated records only. Raw-zone kinds are never returned and kind=dump/item is refused.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Repeated or comma-separated: note, decision, attempt, handoff, state.

get.description: Read-only review report: findings with severity/why/next/confirm, due reviews, pending proposals and the quarantined count. project is optional; an all-projects report sets project_id to * and names each item's project_id.

post.description: Applies the same safe fixes as brain review --fix: adopts the next action of a later handoff and removes open questions a later record answers. The default is a dry run; writing needs apply=true, and dry_run=true with apply is refused. Semantic fixes are never performed.

get.description: The quarantine inbox: unreviewed external writes and unknown origins, newest first, without bodies. Age is whole seconds since creation.

post.description: Marks one quarantined record reviewed, optionally replacing its trust, like brain record review. A record with an unknown origin stays quarantined because review cannot repair a malformed origin. Records have no revision, so review is idempotent and has no compare-and-swap.

get.description: Candidate records with source health. Bodies stay out unless include_body=true; the page shares a body budget and items past it are marked body_omitted. Candidates hidden by an active snooze are omitted unless a status filter is given or include_snoozed=true.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Repeated or comma-separated: pending, stale, promoted, dismissed.

parameters.name: include_body
parameters.description: Render each candidate's redacted text under max_tokens.

parameters.name: include_snoozed
parameters.description: Keep candidates hidden by a snooze that has not come due.

get.description: One candidate with its bounded redacted body; the preview a promotion would create.

post.description: Promotes one pending proposal. Nothing is promoted automatically; as/status/title override the created record, force allows a stale or orphaned source and yes confirms a local-only source. The call is idempotent.
Dismisses one proposal. Repeating the dismissal is idempotent; dismissing a promoted proposal is 409.

Hides a pending or stale candidate from the review queue until a time. until accepts an RFC3339 time, a calendar date, a positive duration (7d) or null to clear; repeating the stored value writes nothing. expected_updated_at makes the write a compare-and-swap and a stale value returns 409 with error.current_revision. Snoozing a promoted or dismissed proposal is 400 validation.

200.description: The candidate after the snooze write

delete.description: Clears the snooze of one candidate. The call is idempotent: clearing a candidate that is not snoozed succeeds unchanged.

200.description: The candidate after clearing its snooze

get.description: Recent changes since the latest handoff, an explicit since, or the default window.

post.description: Checks/applies an engine update only after explicit confirmation.

get.description: Reads the git sync state of the agent's data repository, including divergence, dirty files and conflict records.

post.description: Commits local changes, pulls with rebase and optionally pushes. A content conflict returns 409 sync_conflict and changes nothing else; refresh GET /v1/sync for the conflict paths.

ProjectOptional.name: project
ProjectOptional.description: A registered project id, alias or path. Omit it (or pass all_projects=true) to read every project this API serves; a non-empty allowlist requires an explicit project unless it holds exactly one.

AllProjects.name: all_projects
AllProjects.description: Reads every project the API's allowlist serves. Mutually exclusive with project and refused when the allowlist names several projects.

Since.name: since
Since.description: A positive duration (24h, 7d, 2w), a date (2026-11-01) or an RFC3339 time.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page; bound to its query.

connection_id.description: The same id under the memory-route naming.

project_ids.description: Projects of the connection record, when it is known.

actor.description: Reserved and omitted: run records do not persist who triggered a run.

tags.description: Note tags; omitted for every other kind.

reviewed.description: Must be true when present: a review clears a quarantine and never re-arms one.

trust.description: Optional replacement trust; omit to keep the stored one.

expected_updated_at.description: The updated_at the client read; omit for a last-write-wins review.

reviewed.description: Must be true when present: a review clears a quarantine and never re-arms one.

trust.description: Optional replacement trust; omit to keep the stored one.

expected_revision.description: The state revision the client read; omit for a last-write-wins review.

fresh_until.description: RFC3339 time to mark the state current until; an empty string clears it; omit to keep it.

snoozed_until.description: When a snoozed candidate returns to the inbox.

snoozed.description: The candidate is hidden until snoozed_until.

body.description: Redacted candidate text; present only with include_body=true.

body_omitted.description: The item's body did not fit the page budget.

until.description: RFC3339 time, calendar date, positive duration (7d) or null to clear.

expected_updated_at.description: The updated_at the client read; a stale value is 409 with error.current_revision.

force.description: Allow a stale or orphaned source (CLI --force).

yes.description: Confirm promotion from a local-only source (CLI --yes).

project_ids.description: The scope of an all-projects review.

pending_count.description: Pending candidates only; an active snooze is excluded.

snoozed_count.description: Pending or stale candidates hidden by a snooze that has not come due.

findings_truncated.description: The all-projects aggregate hit its findings cap.

dry_run.description: Preview only. Combining dry_run=true with apply=true is refused.

apply.description: Explicit confirmation to write the safe fixes.

kinds.description: Optional finding kinds to fix; empty fixes every fixable kind.
